title: Method of the Meteor Hand
summary: A method for those past the primers that drops starlight on the foe like a meteor and showers the field with shards.

title: A Treatise on Pulsing Stars
summary: A treatise on starlight that beats in a steady pulse and can be thrown out of time into a foe or in time into a friend.

title: The Zenith and Nadir Course
summary: A course in striking from the highest point and pressing down to the lowest so the foe is caught between the two.

title: Notes on the Corona Guard
summary: Notes on a bright ring of starlight worn about the body that shields the wearer and flares to dazzle the foe.

title: The Constellation Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the lines that join the small stars of the qi field into patterns that pierce guard and shield friend.
